source_properties: Model material uses the existing artifact/coordination/lease authority with a separate model document/hash and an additive material-kind column. Native authoring and hash formats are unchanged.
Tests save model material through the real EF writer and use its returned incarnation; no hand-built model artifact rows remain in these checkpoint fixtures.
Actual root grants, fenced source publication, complete child pins, retained model execution roots, staging grace and orphan collection are exercised on SQLite.
Known cache/invalidating decorators explicitly preserve model material operations; opaque decorators retain default refusal.
correction: The previous checkpoint fixture encoded ArtifactHash unlike the real artifact provider. Shared ReadMaterial validation and tests using actual SaveModelAsync remove that mismatch. Prior checkpoint-only results are historical and were not actual runnable material proof.

migrations.baseline_upgrade: Actual captured runtime.sqlite.gz: original column values retained, artifact kind defaults to native, original history preserved, and both additive migrations applied.
